name: dealflow-meeting-notes
description: Turn a meeting transcript into minutes, key findings and follow-ups linked to the right project.

label.zh-CN: 把这份转写整理成纪要

body.en: Follow this skill (after reading `busa-dealflow`) on the transcript or notes I give you: find the project without creating a duplicate, write the meeting record and its follow-ups, update the project, and send me the links.
body.zh-CN: 先读 `busa-dealflow`，再按本技能处理我给你的转写或笔记：找到对应项目（不要重复建），写入会议记录和待跟进，更新项目，最后把链接发给我。

label.en: Try the flow on the sample transcript

body.en: Read `busa-dealflow`, then run this skill on `examples/sample-transcript-yunshan.md` from this skill's files (it is invented sample data). Show me what you would write before writing it.
body.zh-CN: 先读 `busa-dealflow`，再用本技能文件里的 `examples/sample-transcript-yunshan.md`（虚构示例）试跑一遍。写入前先把要写的内容给我看。

label.en: Check a meeting record against the playbook
label.zh-CN: 按手册检查一条会议记录

body.en: Check the meeting record I name against this skill's checklist: project link, title format, findings, follow-up owners and dates, no financial figures. List what to fix; do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 按本技能的检查清单检查我说的那条会议记录：项目关联、标题格式、关键发现、待跟进的负责人和日期、有没有财务数字。列出要改的地方，不要修改任何记录。

label.en: Add a new team rule to this playbook
label.zh-CN: 把一条新规矩写进这份手册

body.en: Fold the rule I describe into this skill's SKILL.md where it belongs, keeping the rest unchanged, and show me the diff before proposing it.
body.zh-CN: 把我描述的新规矩写进本技能 SKILL.md 合适的位置，其他内容不动，提交前先给我看改动。
